aboutMe: I am a full-stack developer based in Bangladesh. I build web applications with React, Next.js, and Node.js, focusing on backend architecture, authentication, database design, and real-world business workflows. Most of my work involves building complete platforms from scratch — including headless e-commerce, offline-first PWAs, and learning management systems.
